blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems where social attribution, the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents' social behaviors, plays a critical role. These processes involve judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and cognition through Attribution Theory, social attribution remains underexplored in AI, particularly LLM social reasoning. This paper provides the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs' judgments and their underlying internal mechanisms. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. Some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench.
blocks.zh: 在社会技术体系中,大语言模型(LLMS)日益被运用,社会归属,将外部事件归因于代理人社会行为的起因和原因的推理过程,发挥着关键作用. 这些过程涉及对社会事业、责任和对代理人的指责/信用的判断。 虽然归属模型通过归属理论在社会心理学和认知学中得到了很好的研究,但社会归属在AI中仍然没有得到充分的探讨,尤其是LLM社会推理. 本文为LLM社会归属的首次系统探索. 我们的工作重点是责任和责任归属,审查目前法学硕士的判断及其内部机制。 以归属论为指导,我们构建了一个由Vignette子集组成的社会归属基准,该子集基于归属论研究的经典情景,而现实子集基于现实世界的社会叙事,产生7,639个责任/指责的判断问题. 在此基础上,我们评估了32项具有代表性的有限责任措施和5项基本非有限责任清单基线。 为了进一步探索LLM判断过程所依据的内部机制,我们开发了一种基于检验的方法,以调查5个关键归属层面的潜在空间表现及其与人类社会归属层面相比对LLM判断的影响的一致性。 我们的研究结果表明,目前的有限责任管理办法与人的责任和责难判断有可衡量但不完整的一致,与此同时,这种一致与模型规模是正相关联的。 一些归属维度从LLM隐藏状态中的特定位置上系统地解码,它们对于最终判断的影响与人类归属理论所显示的一致. 数据集和相关代码见https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks ranging from natural language understanding and generation, interactive conversations, to complex problem solving ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) . With the continuous progress of advanced AI technologies, LLMs have shown broader impacts in the social realm and been integrated into sociotechnical applications, such as social simulation ( Park et al., 2023 ) , human-AI interactions ( Hadan et al., 2025 ) , social learning ( Goindani and Neville, 2019 ) , and normative reasoning ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) . In such settings, inaccurate responsibility or blame attribution can lead to concrete harms, for example, in legal and social service assistance, incorrect attribution may mislead responsibility judgments; in mental health and healthcare settings, incorrect blame may lead to victim-blaming or unsafe advice ( Dahl et al., 2024 ) ; and in content moderation or community governance, incorrect blame may cause victims to be treated as violators ( Moore et al., 2025 ) . A critical topic underlying these diverse applications is the reliance on social attribution ( Gratch et al., 2006 ; Malle, 2022 ) , the social reasoning process that centers on attributing the occurrence of external events to the causes and reasons of agents’ social behaviors, and assigning responsibility, blame, or credit to the involved agents in rich social interactions. Such social inference reflects how agents make sense of and act on the social world around them, and lies at the heart of social intelligence.
blocks.zh: 近年来,大型语言模型(LLMs)在从自然语言理解和生成,交互对话到复杂的问题解决(Achiam等,2023年)等任务中表现出了强大的能力. 随着先进AI技术的不断进步,LLM在社会领域显示出了更广泛的影响并被融入了社会技术应用,如:社会模拟(Park等,2023年),人与AI互动(Hadan等,2025年),社会学习(Goindani和Neville,2019年),规范推理(Yuan等,2024年)等. 在这种情况下,不准确的责任或责任归属可能导致具体伤害,例如在法律和社会服务援助方面,不正确的归属可能误导对责任的判断;在精神健康和医疗保健方面,不正确的归属可能导致对受害者的指责或不安全的建议(Dahl等人,2024年);在内容温和或社区治理方面,不正确的归属可能导致将受害者视为违反者(Moore等人,2025年)。 支撑这些不同应用的一个关键话题是依赖社会归属(Gratch等人,2006年;Malle,2022年),社会推理过程的核心是将外部事件的发生归咎于代理人的社会行为的原因和原因,并将责任、责难或信用归于参与丰富社会互动的代理人。 这种社会推论反映了代理人如何感同身受,如何对周围的社会世界采取行动,并处于社会智能的核心.

blocks.en:
Social attribution is a fundamental field of research in social psychology and social cognition, and has been well-studied. For decades, researchers have established Attribution Theory ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) as the dominant theoretical framework. In these theoretical models, the central theme involves the judgments of social cause, responsibility and blame/credit. Such judgments are not driven by outcomes alone, but systematically shaped by a set of key attributional dimensions, such as intention , voluntariness , foreknowledge , controllability , and obligation , that characterize agents’ mental states and the nature of their involvement in social events.
In computational research on social attribution, previous work has built computational frameworks to model this judgment process grounded in attribution theory ( Mao et al., 2011 ; Mao and Gratch, 2012 ) . More recently, several works propose to leverage LLMs primarily for normative or legal reasoning ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Guha et al., 2023 ) . Despite the importance of social attribution in theoretical foundations and broader applications, it is still underexplored in the computing/information science community, and especially in LLM social reasoning.
blocks.zh:
社会归属是社会心理学和社会认知研究的一个基本领域,并得到了很好的研究. 几十年来,研究人员将Attribution Theory(Shaver,1985;Weiner,1995;Malle等,2014.)确立为主导理论框架. 在这些理论模型中,中心主题涉及对社会事业、责任和指责/信用的判断。 这种判断并非仅由结果驱动,而是由一系列关键归属因素,如意图、自愿性、先入为主、可控性、义务等系统地形成,这些要素是代理人精神状态及其参与社会活动的性质的特点。
在关于社会归属的计算研究中,之前的工作已经构建了基于归属论的计算框架来模拟这一判断过程(Mao等,2011;Mao和Gratch,2012.). 最近,有几部作品提议主要利用法学硕士课程进行规范或法律推理(袁等,2024;古哈等,2023)。 尽管社会归属在理论基础和更广泛的应用中很重要,但在计算/信息科学界,特别是在LLM社会推理方面,它仍然没有得到充分发挥.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we focus on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs’ performances in making responsibility and blame judgments, as well as their internal mechanisms underlying such judgments.
Specifically, to explore current LLMs’ performances in making responsibility and blame judgments, we raise the first research question: How accurate are current LLMs in attributing responsibility and blame compared to human judgments? Furthermore, given the judgment process and the intermediate cognitive variables (i.e., attribution dimensions) clearly identified by attribution theory, it remains unclear whether a similar process exists in LLM social reasoning and to what extent LLM social attribution resembles that of human judgments in the internal social and cognitive mechanisms described in attribution theory. Therefore, we raise deeper research questions: Are social attribution dimensions identified in human theory actually represented in LLMs’ internal hidden states? and further: Do the influences of LLMs’ dimension representations on judgments align with human social attribution theory?
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们侧重于责任和责怪归属,审查目前法学硕士在作出责任和责怪判断方面的表现以及这些判断所依据的内部机制。
具体地说,为了探讨目前法学硕士在做出责任和责怪判断方面的表现,我们提出了第一个研究问题: 与人类的判断相比,目前的法学硕士和法学硕士对责任和责难的归属如何准确? 此外,鉴于归属论明确确定的判断过程和中间认知变量(即归属维度),仍然不清楚在LLM社会推理中是否存在类似的过程,以及LLM社会归属在多大程度上类似于归属论所描述的内部社会和认知机制中的人类判断. 因此,我们提出更深入的研究问题: 人类理论中确认的社会归属层面是否在LLMs的内部隐藏状态中得到体现? 并且还: LLMs的维度对判断的影响是否与人类社会归属理论一致?

blocks.en:
To answer these research questions, we conduct one of the first systematic studies of social attribution in LLM reasoning. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a bilingual social attribution benchmark consisting of two complementary subsets. One subset is built from classic scenarios in attribution theory research based on vignette paradigm, enabling controlled manipulation of attribution dimensions across different inter-agent relations and social situations. The other subset is constructed from real-world social narratives to introduce more realistic and ambiguous social attribution scenarios. After expert annotation and filtering, the benchmark contains 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions.
On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs, including 9 closed-source and 23 open-source models, and compare them with 5 basic non-LLM baselines. This evaluation addresses RQ1 by measuring both exact agreement with human responsibility/blame labels and relative agreement in multi-agent attribution rankings.
blocks.zh:
为了回答这些研究问题,我们对LLM推理中的社会归属进行了最早的系统研究之一. 以归属论为指导,我们构建了由两个互补子集组成的双语社会归属基准. 其中一个子集是建立在Vignette范式基础上的归属理论研究中的经典情景所构建的,它允许在不同代理关系和社会状况中控制地操纵归属维度. 另一个子集则由现实世界的社会叙事来构建,以引入更加现实和模糊的社会归属假设. 在专家说明和过滤后,基准包含7 639个责任/指责判决问题。
在此基础上,我们评价了32个有代表性的LLM,包括9个闭源模型和23个开源模型,并将其与5个基本非LLM基线进行比较. 本评价涉及RQ1,衡量与人的责任/责任标签的确切一致,以及在多代理人归属排名中的相对一致。

blocks.en: To answer the second and third research questions of investigating the internal mechanisms in LLM social attribution, we leverage a dimension-level probing framework to examine the existence of dimension representations in LLM hidden states and their influences on the final judgments. In mechanistic interpretability for LLMs, a rich toolbox of well-established methods has been developed ( Huben et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang, 2025 ) . Among them, the probing technique is typically adopted in studying dimension-based cognitive or psychological representations within LLMs, mainly because it enables a quantitative alignment between theory-derived dimensional variables and LLM hidden states ( Tak et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2025 ; Zhang, 2025 ) . In our probing-based framework, to examine the existence of dimension representations, we first train linear probes on the hidden states, leveraging the annotations of the key attribution dimensions from our constructed benchmark. We then conduct an empirical analysis across layers and dimensions to investigate the representation strength of each dimension at different latent regions. To further examine the influences of dimension representations on responsibility and blame judgments, we directionally vary the LLM hidden states along specific dimension representations to quantify the extent to which the final judgments are affected, and conduct rigorous hypothesis testing to verify the consistency of these impacts with the human judgment patterns indicated in attribution theory.
blocks.zh: 为了回答关于调查LLM社会归属的内部机制的第二和第三个研究问题,我们利用一个维度水平的测试框架来审查LLM隐蔽状态中存在维度表述及其对最终判断的影响. 在LLMS的机械解释性方面,开发了一套丰富的既定方法工具箱(Huben等,2024;张等,2025;张等,2025)。 其中,在研究LLMs内部基于维度的认知或心理表现时,典型地采用了检测技术,这主要是因为它能使理论衍生的维变量与LLM隐藏状态在数量上一致(Tak等,2025;Kang等,2025;Zhang,2025). 在我们基于探索的框架中,为了研究维度表达的存在,我们首先在隐藏状态上进行线性探测,利用我们构建的基准中对关键归属层面的说明。 然后,我们进行不同层次和层面的经验分析,以调查每个层面在不同潜在区域的代表性强度。 为了进一步审查维度表述对责任和责难判断的影响,我们根据具体维度表述来定向地改变LLM隐藏状态,以量化最终判断的影响程度,并进行严格的假设测试,以核实这些影响与归属理论中指明的人类判断模式的一致性.

blocks.en: Our research contributions and findings are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的研究贡献和调查结果概述如下:

blocks.en: 1. We focus on the fundamental research problem of LLM social attribution with wide applications, and present one of the first systematic studies on LLM responsibility and blame judgments as well as the internal mechanisms underlying such judgments. 2. We construct a bilingual social attribution benchmark consisting of a controlled vignette subset and a realistic social scenario subset, and conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation on 32 representative LLMs and 5 classical baselines. 3. We develop a latent space dimension probing methodology that employs a probe-based technique to quantify the decodability of attribution dimensions and dimension-level influences, and on this basis, investigate the existence of dimensional representations in LLM hidden states and their influence mechanisms. 4. Our empirical findings demonstrate that specific attribution dimensions are represented within the latent space of LLMs, and their influences on LLM final judgments align with those of human social attribution theory.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
LLMs for normative judgments. Recent research systematically evaluates LLMs’ attribution-related behaviors in social contexts ( Xu et al., 2024 ) .
Benchmarks typically address two categories of judgment: (1) social-norm judgments, using everyday, context-dependent rules of thumb to evaluate whether models generate or select norm-consistent explanations and behavioral recommendations ( Forbes et al., 2020 ; Jiang et al., 2021 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Chakraborty et al., 2025 ) ; and (2) legal judgments, grounded in statutes, precedents, and legal reasoning, assessing performance and reliability in legal question answering, case analysis, and decision recommendation ( Guha et al., 2023 ; Fei et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2025 ) .
These studies primarily adopt a normative or prescriptive perspective.
We instead take a descriptive perspective, modeling systematic patterns in LLM responsibility and blame judgments and evaluating their alignment with human judgments, without assuming that human judgments conform to universal principles of rationality.
Our benchmark further annotates five theory-derived attribution dimensions to examine the intermediate variables underlying these judgments.
blocks.zh:
规范判决法学硕士。 最近的研究系统地评价了LLMs在社会背景下与归属有关的行为(徐等,2024年).
基准一般涉及两类判决:(1) 社会规范判决,利用日常的、依背景而定的拇指规则来评价模型是否产生或选择符合规范的解释和行为建议(Forbes等,2020年;Jiang等,2021年;Yuan等,2024年;Agarwal等,2024年;Jin等,2025年;Ji等,2025年;Chakraborty等,2025年);和(2) 法律判决,以法规、先例和法律推理为基础,评估在回答法律问题、案件分析和决定建议方面的绩效和可靠性(Guha等,2023年;Fei等,2024年;Dai等,2025年)。
这些研究主要采取规范性或规范性观点。
相反,我们采取描述性的观点,模拟LLM责任的系统模式并责怪判断,评价判断与人类判断的一致性,而不假定人类判断符合理性的普遍原则.
我们的基准进一步说明五个理论产生的归属层面,以审查这些判断所依据的中间变量。

blocks.en:
LLM Probing for Mechanism Exploration. Probing measures the decodability of target variables from LLM hidden states using lightweight predictors ( Belinkov and Glass, 2019 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) .
Studies examine factual and relational knowledge ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Hernandez et al., 2024 ) , instruction following ( Heo et al., 2025 ) , and truth-related signals ( Orgad et al., 2025 ) , sometimes combining representation analysis with activation interventions to assess their influence on outputs.
Social and cognitive studies investigate modality reliance through prompt perturbations ( Qi et al., 2023 ) , stereotypical patterns in emotion attribution ( Plaza-del-Arco et al., 2024 ) , and latent value structures ( Kang et al., 2025 ) .
More directly related to our methodology, Tak et al. (2025) probe theory-derived cognitive appraisal dimensions and intervene on their representations to influence emotion inference.
Other studies examine the decodability and steerability of self- and personality-related constructs ( Ju et al., 2025 ) and ideological positions ( Zhang, 2025 ) .
These findings motivate theory-guided probing and interventions for LLM social reasoning; however, to the best of our knowledge, prior work has not specifically probed attribution dimensions underlying responsibility and blame judgments.

其他研究考察了自有和人格相关构象(Ju等,2025年)和思想立场(Zhang,2025年)的可解和可导性.
这些调查结果激励了对LLM社会推理进行理论指导的检验和干预;然而,据我们所知,先前的工作并没有具体探讨责任和责怪判断的归属层面。

blocks.en: 3 Theoretical Foundation
blocks.zh: 3个理论基金会

blocks.en:
Responsibility and blame judgments. Responsibility judgment assesses the extent to which an agent is accountable for an event, considering causal involvement, controllability, and mitigating factors such as coercion or lack of foreknowledge.
Blame judgment further assesses whether the agent deserves moral criticism, taking justifications and excuses into account.
Responsibility thus presupposes causality but is not reducible to it; similarly, responsibility is a prerequisite for blame but does not necessarily entail blameworthiness ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ) .
blocks.zh:
责任和责难的判断。 责任判断评估代理人对某一事件负责的程度,考虑到因果关系、可控制性和诸如胁迫或缺乏前科等减轻因素。
责难的判断进一步评估了代理人是否值得在道德上受到批评,同时考虑到理由和借口.
因此,责任以因果关系为先决条件,但不能减轻责任;同样,责任是责备的先决条件,但不一定引起责备(Shaver, 1985;Weiner, 1995)。

blocks.en:
Attribution theories and dimensions. Classic attribution theories characterize responsibility and blame judgments through structured assessments of attribution dimensions, which capture agents’ causal involvement, mental states, and situational constraints ( Weiner, 1995 ; Shaver, 1985 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) ; see Appendix A.1 for detailed accounts and illustrations.
Drawing on these theories, we focus on five dimensions (Appendix A.2 ): 1. Intention. Whether the agent deliberately performed the focal action according to a goal or plan.
Here, intention concerns the action itself, not the outcome it produces. 2. Voluntariness. Whether the agent acted freely rather than under external coercion, authority, or situational pressure, even without an explicit threat. 3. Foreknowledge. Whether the agent knew or, given their epistemic and cognitive conditions, should have foreseen the outcome.
Foreknowledge typically increases attributed responsibility and blame ( Shaver, 1985 ) . 4. Controllability. Whether the agent had the practical capacity to prevent the outcome, including the necessary means, skills, or opportunity. 5. Obligation. Whether the agent had a duty to prevent the negative outcome given the situation and social relationship, a key consideration in attributing responsibility or blame for unintentional outcomes.

归属论和维度. 典型的归属理论通过对归属层面的有条理的评估来描述责任和责难的判断,这种评估记录了代理人的因果参与、精神状态和情况限制(Weiner,1995年;Shaver,1995年)。 1985年;Malle等,2014年;详见附录A.1。
基于这些理论,我们侧重于五个维度(附录A.2): 1. 意图。 代理人是否根据目标或计划故意实施联络行动.
在这方面,意图涉及的是行动本身,而不是它所产生的结果。 2.志愿. 代理人是自由行事,而不是在外部胁迫、权威或局势压力下行事,即使没有明显的威胁。 3. 前知识。 代理人是否知道,或鉴于其认知和认知条件,是否应预见到结果。
知识通常会增加责任和责任(Shaver, 1985年)。 4. 可控性。 代理人是否具备防止结果的实际能力,包括必要的手段、技能或机会。 5. 义务。 鉴于情况和社会关系,代理人是否有义务防止负面结果,这是将无意结果的责任或责任归罪于它的一个关键考虑因素。

blocks.en: 4.1 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 数据构建

blocks.en:
To address the lack of a dedicated data resource for systematically studying LLM social attribution, we first construct a benchmark that pairs human responsibility/blame judgments with theory-derived attribution dimensions.
The benchmark comprises two complementary subsets, Vignette and Reality , supporting both behavioral evaluation and analysis of the representations underlying these judgments.
Figure 1 summarizes construction and evaluation.
blocks.zh:
为了解决缺乏专门数据资源来系统地研究LLM的社会归属问题,我们首先构建了一个基准,将人的责任/指责判断与理论衍生的归属层面联系起来。
基准包括两个相辅相成的子集:Vignette和Reality,支持行为评价和分析这些判断所依据的表述。
图1总结了施工和评价情况。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Benchmark construction and evaluation of LLM social attribution.

blocks.en:
The Vignette subset draws on classic scenarios from psychological attribution research, preserving their theoretical grounding while using structured narratives to precisely control attribution dimensions.
Following the vignette paradigm ( Baguley et al., 2022 ) , we construct 11 templates spanning eight scenario types and three inter-agent relation categories: general interactions, vicarious blame, and command–obedience chains.
Dimension values constrained by each role structure are fixed, while the remaining values are systematically varied.
To reduce surface shortcuts, we diversify narrative details and phrasing, randomize names and genders, and avoid explicit dimension labels.
Each scenario involves multiple agents, with a separate responsibility question and a separate blame question for each agent.
Appendix B.1 details the construction.
The Reality subset captures realistic and ambiguous social interactions through narratives posted by real users, complementing the controlled Vignette settings.
Following the story-reconstruction approach of Forbes et al. (2020) , we select Reddit AITA posts with clear negative outcomes and reconstruct them into concise narratives.
LLM-assisted preprocessing and inspection remove irrelevant or harmful content and identifying information, replacing identities with fictional names.
For each scenario, we select a single target agent and ask separate responsibility and blame questions about that agent.
Appendices B.2 and B.3 specify the models, processing steps, and prompts.
Both subsets are constructed in Chinese and English.

按照Vignette范式(Baguley等,2022年),我们构建了11个模板,涵盖8个情景类型和3个代理关系类别:一般互动、间接指责和命令链。
受每个角色结构所制约的维度值是固定的,而其余的值则有系统的变化.

每种情况都涉及多个代理人,对每个代理人分别提出责任问题和单独的责任问题.
附录B.1详细介绍了施工情况。

To address RQ1, we use two metrics to quantify agreement between LLM and human responsibility and blame judgments.
Outputs are canonicalized to 𝒜 \mathcal{A} (Appendix C.3 ).
Accuracy is the proportion of valid predictions that exactly match human labels, measuring agreement on the absolute level of responsibility or blame assigned to an agent.
Mapping ( no , low , medium , high ) (\texttt{no},\texttt{low},\texttt{medium},\texttt{high}) to ( 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 ) (0,1,2,3) through r r , we also compute Spearman correlation between predicted and human agent rankings within each Vignette scenario, assigning average ranks to ties.
This metric measures agreement on which agents are more responsible or blameworthy relative to others, even when the predicted judgment levels differ from human labels.
We report the mean correlation across scenarios.
Invalid predictions are excluded from accuracy, and scenarios containing them are excluded from correlation (Appendix C.4 ).

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate 32 LLMs: nine closed-source LLMs from the Claude, Doubao Seed, Gemini, GPT, Grok, Kimi, MiMo, and Step families, and 23 open-source LLMs from the Llama, Phi, GPT-oss, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen, Gemma, GLM, and InternLM families.
The open-source models span 0.5–120B parameters; Appendix C.1 provides the full model list and inference settings.
We evaluate each LLM with four prompt strategies: Direct (answer without reasoning), CoT (reason step by step), Self-reflection (review and revise an initial judgment), and Theory-guided (analyze the five attribution dimensions before judging).
For comparison, we evaluate five non-LLM models: Random Stratified (sample labels according to their frequencies), Majority Class (predict the most frequent label), Heuristic Rule (score textual keywords), Attribution-Theory Rule (apply theory-based rules to annotated dimensions), and mBERT Classifier (predict labels with fine-tuned multilingual BERT).
Performance is measured by accuracy and Spearman’s ρ \rho , as defined in Section 4 .
Prompt templates and non-LLM model details are provided in Appendices C.2 and C.5 .
blocks.zh:
我们评价了32个LLMs:来自克洛德、杜宝种子、双子座、GPT、格罗克、基米、米莫和斯德克家族的9个闭源LLMs;来自Llama、Phi、GPT-oss、DeepSeek-R1、Quen、Gemma、GLM和InternLM家族的23个开源LMs。
开源模型跨0.5–120B参数;附录C.1提供了完整的模型列表和推论设置.
我们用四个迅速的战略来评估每个LLM: 直接(无推理的回答),CoT(分步解释),自反(审查和修改初步判断),理论指导(在判断前分析五个归属层面).
为了比较起见,我们评价了五个非LLM模型:随机分级(根据它们的频率进行抽样标签),多数类(预测最频繁的标签),Heuristic Rule(核心文本关键词),Attribution-Theory Rule(将理论规则应用于附加注释的维度)和mBERT Classifier(预想标签带有微调多语言BERT).
如第4节所定义的那样,性能以精确度和Spearman的活性衡量。
附录C.2和C.5提供了快速模板和非LLM模型细节。

blocks.en:
To understand how attribution dimensions are represented and influence LLM judgments, we examine their decodability in hidden states and whether their influences on judgments align with human attribution theory.
We use DeepSeek-R1-1.5B, Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B as backbones with CoT prompts, following the methods in Section 4.2 .
Reported decodability plots recompute balanced accuracy from held-out predictions pooled across languages and subsets (Appendix D.2 ).
Hyperparameters, implementation, and testing details are provided in Appendices D.4 and D.5 .

为了了解归属维度是如何代表和影响LLM判断的,我们考察了它们在隐藏状态中的可解码性,以及它们对判断的影响是否与人类归属论一致.
我们采用DeepSeek-R1-1.5B,Llama-3.2-1B,Llama-3.1-8B,Qune3-4B,和Qune3-8B作为骨干,带有CoT提示,采用第4.2节中的方法.
报告的可解码地块根据不同语言和子集的搁置预测重新计算平衡准确度(附录D.2)。
附录D.4和D.5提供了超参数、实施和测试细节。

blocks.en: 5.2 Performance Evaluation on LLM Social Attribution
blocks.zh: 5.2 对LLM社会归属的绩效评价

blocks.en:
Figure 3 compares agreement with human judgments across models, averaging each LLM’s results over the four prompting strategies.
Grok-4.3 achieves the highest scores on both metrics when averaged across responsibility and blame, with 58.00% accuracy and ρ = 0.627 \rho=0.627 .

图3比较了不同模型中人类的判断一致,将每种LLM的结果平均比起四种激励战略。
Grok-4.3在对责任和责难进行平均衡量时,在两个指标上都取得了最高的分数,准确度为58.00 %,而 ^ 0.627\rho=0.627.

blocks.en:
For most models, accuracy is higher on responsibility than on blame, whereas Spearman’s ρ \rho shows the opposite pattern.
It is because assigning a blame level requires finer judgments of moral severity and mitigating circumstances: models may preserve relative differences in blame among agents while differing from humans on the precise level assigned.

对大多数模型来说,责任的准确性高于责难,而斯皮尔曼的 $\rho 则显示了相反的模式.
这是因为分配责任级别需要更细致地判断道德严重性和减轻处罚情节:模型可能保持代理人之间的责任相对不同,而人类在分配的确切级别上有所不同。

The supervised mBERT classifier achieves accuracy comparable to selected 4–8B LLMs: 43.47% on responsibility, versus 43.13% for Gemma3-4B, and 31.60% on blame, versus 33.23% for Llama3.1-8B (Appendix Table 15 ).
Its limited accuracy may reflect difficulty learning agent-specific roles and obligations from the available supervision.

Across the 23 open-source models, both accuracy and ranking agreement increase with log-scale parameter count (Figure 4 ).
The fitted slopes are positive for both metrics ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), with R 2 = 0.766 R^{2}=0.766 for accuracy and R 2 = 0.806 R^{2}=0.806 for ρ \rho .

blocks.en: 5.3 Decodability of Attribution Dimensions in LLM Hidden States
blocks.zh: 5.3 LLM 隐藏国的归属因素的可解码性

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows the decodability of attribution dimensions at the label-token prediction step across five models, both judgment tasks, and normalized layer depths.
blocks.zh: 图5显示在标本预测步骤上跨越五个模型的归属维度的可解码性,既包括判断任务,也包括平分层深度.

blocks.en:
Attribution dimensions are consistently decodable from hidden states, with most middle and later layers scoring above chance.
Intention and obligation show the highest decodability, approaching 90% in Llama-3.1-8B and the Qwen models.
Foreknowledge is weaker, particularly in DeepSeek-R1-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B, while voluntariness and controllability vary more across models.
Responsibility and blame show similar patterns in dimension strength and layerwise variation.
blocks.zh:
分配维度从隐藏状态一直可以解码,大多数中层和后层的分数都高于机会.
意向和义务显示的可解码性最高,在Llama-3.1-8B和Quen模型中接近90%.
前知识较弱,特别是在DeepSeek-R1-1.5B和Llama-3.2-1B,而自愿性和可控性则因模型而异.
责任和指责在维度强度和分层变化方面显示出类似的规律.

blocks.en:
Decodability generally increases from early to middle layers and remains high across later layers.
Some dimensions plateau or decline slightly near the output, with peak decodability often occurring before the final layer.
This pattern is consistent with attribution information becoming easier to read out as the model integrates the scenario context.
blocks.zh:
解码性一般从早期到中层增加,并保持高地跨越后层.
一些维度高地或略接近输出地会下降,峰值可解码性常会发生在最后地层之前.
这种模式与归属信息相一致,因为模型融入了情景背景,因此更容易被读出.

blocks.en:
Sanity checks further support these findings (see Appendix Figures 10 – 14 ).
Across all five models, the original probes outperform the shuffled-label control, which stays near chance, and generally outperform the 64-dimensional random-projection control.
For Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B, they also exceed the scenario-text TF-IDF control across most layers.
blocks.zh:
卫生检查进一步证实了这些调查结果(见附录图10至图14)。
在所有五个模型中,原始探测器的性能都超过了被洗发的-标签控制器,它保持了近乎偶然的性能,一般也超过了64维的随机投影控制.
对于Llama-3.1-8B,Quen3-4B,和Quen3-8B,它们也超越了大多数层的情景文本TF-IDF控制.

blocks.en: For RQ2, these results provide evidence that the evaluated LLMs encode linearly decodable information about attribution dimensions, with strength varying across dimensions, models, and layers.
blocks.zh: 对于RQ2,这些结果提供了证据,证明被评价的LLMS编码了关于归属维度的可线性解码信息,其强度因维度,模型,层而异.

blocks.en: 5.4 Influence of Attribution Dimensions on Judgment
blocks.zh: 5.4 分配问题对判决的影响

blocks.en:
Figure 6 shows whether interventions along attribution-dimension representations shift responsibility and blame judgments in the directions predicted by attribution theory.
Intention and obligation show the most consistent effects: at 60% and 80% relative depth, both dimensions satisfy the directional tests in all five models and both tasks.
These effects hold against the unedited baseline and both intervention controls.
This pattern also matches the high decodability of intention and obligation observed in the preceding analysis.
blocks.zh:
图6显示,在归属论预测的方向上,归属分配表述方面的干预措施是否转移了责任和责难判断。
意向和义务表现出最一致的效果:在60%和80%的相对深度,两个维度都满足所有五个模型和两个任务的方向测试.
这些影响与未经编辑的基线和两种干预控制相悖。
这一模式也与前述分析所述意图和义务的高可解码性相匹配。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Layerwise influence of attribution dimensions. Blue cells pass all three question-level directional-success tests ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ); gray cells do not. Rows denote dimensions; 100% denotes the final layer.
blocks.zh: 图6:归属维度的分层影响。 蓝色单元格通过所有三个问题级方向-成功测试(p < 0.01 p < 0.01);灰色单元格不通过. 行表示尺寸;100%表示最后一层。

blocks.en:
Theory-aligned effects are concentrated in the middle and later layers, particularly between 40% and 80% relative depth.
The 60% depth has the broadest support, with 33 of 50 settings passing the tests, compared with six at 20% depth and nine at the final layer.
Llama-3.2-1B retains several significant effects at the final layer, while the other models show fewer.
blocks.zh:
理论相通效应集中在中层和后层,尤其是相对深度在40%至80%之间.
60%的深度得到最广泛的支持,50个设置中有33个通过测试,而6个深度为20%,9个在最后一层。
Llama-3.2-1B在最后一层保留了好几项显著效果,而其他模型显示较少.

blocks.en:
The remaining dimensions show more variation across models and tasks.
Foreknowledge produces significant effects on both tasks in the Llama models, while the Qwen models show significant effects only on responsibility.
Voluntariness passes the tests in all five models at selected intermediate layers, including both tasks at 60% and 80% depth in DeepSeek-R1-1.5B.
Controllability has the fewest significant results, appearing at isolated layers.
blocks.zh:
其余的维度显示,模型和任务之间的差异更大。
在Llama模式中,先入为主对这两项任务都产生显著影响,而Quen模式仅对责任产生显著影响。
自愿通过在选定的中间层的所有5个模型中的测试,包括深度为60%和80%的DeepSeek-R1-1.5B任务.
可控性取得的结果最少,出现在孤立的地层上。

blocks.en: For RQ3, the intervention results support theory-aligned influences most consistently for intention and obligation, while alignment for other dimensions depends on the model, task, and layer.
blocks.zh: 就RQ3而言,干预结果支持理论对意图和义务的影响最为一致,而其他层面的调整则取决于模式、任务和层次。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
To understand social attribution as a fundamental aspect of social reasoning, we present the first systematic investigation of LLM responsibility and blame judgments.
Our benchmark comprises a Vignette subset of classic attribution scenarios and a Reality subset of real-world social narratives.
We evaluate 32 LLMs and develop a framework to probe the representations underlying their judgments.
Closed-source models generally outperform open-source models, whose agreement with human judgments is positively associated with model size.
Across five probed models, attribution dimensions are decodable from hidden states, especially intention and obligation.
Interventions on these dimensions produce the most consistent shifts predicted by attribution theory, especially in middle and later layers.
Effects of other dimensions vary across models, tasks, and layers.
Together, these findings connect LLM social attribution behavior with internal representations of factors identified in human attribution theory.
blocks.zh:
为了将社会归属理解为社会推理的一个基本方面,我们提出了对LLM责任和责难判断的第一次系统调查.
我们的基准包括Vignette的经典归属假设子集和Reality的现实世界社会叙事子集。
我们评价了32个法学硕士课程,并制订了一个框架,以探究其判决背后的表述。
封闭源代码模型一般优于开源模型,其与人类判断的一致与模型大小有正相关.
在五个被探测的模型中,归属维度可以从隐藏状态中解码出,特别是意图和义务.
对这些维度的干预产生了由归属论所预测的最相干的变化,特别是在中层和后层.
其他维度的影响因模型、任务和层次而异。
这些发现共同将LLM社会归属行为与人类归属论所认定的因素的内部表现联系起来.

blocks.en: Appendix A Theoretical Background and Operationalization
blocks.zh: 附录A 理论背景和运作

blocks.en: A.1 Classical Attribution Theories
blocks.zh: A.1 传统归属理论

blocks.en: Attribution theories describe how perceivers connect an agent’s actions to an outcome and assess the agent’s responsibility and blameworthiness. These judgments are related but distinct: causal involvement does not by itself establish responsibility, and responsibility does not by itself establish blame. Assessments of control, mental states, coercion, and mitigating circumstances help explain why agents involved in the same negative event can receive different judgments ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ) . This distinction motivates our separate responsibility and blame tasks, as well as annotations of intermediate attribution dimensions rather than final judgments alone.
blocks.zh: 归属论描述了感知者如何将代理人的行为与结果联系起来,并评估代理人的责任和可责备性。 这些判决是相关但截然不同的:因果关系本身并不确定责任,责任本身并不确定责任。 对控制、精神状态、胁迫和减轻罪行的评估有助于解释为何参与同一负面事件的代理人可以得到不同的判决(Shaver, 1985年;Weiner, 1995年)。 这种区分促使我们承担单独的责任和责备任务,以及说明中间归属方面,而不仅仅是最后判断。

blocks.en: (a) Weiner’s responsibility model.
blocks.zh: (a) 魏纳的责任模式。

blocks.en: (b) Shaver’s blame model.
blocks.zh: (b) 沙维尔的指责模式。

blocks.en: (c) Malle et al.’s path model.
blocks.zh: (c) Malle等人的路径模型。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Classic attribution theories organize responsibility and blame judgments around assessments of causality, mental states, control, and mitigating circumstances ( Weiner, 1995 ; Shaver, 1985 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) . The models provide complementary theoretical foundations for the dimensions investigated here; they are not assumed to describe the computational architecture of an LLM.
blocks.zh: 图7:经典归属理论围绕因果关系、精神状态、控制和减轻情节评估组织责任和责备判断(Weiner,1995年;Shaver,1985年;Malle等,2014年)。 这些模型为这里所调查的维度提供了互补的理论基础;它们不被认为是描述LLM的计算架构.

blocks.en: Weiner characterizes causal explanations through separable dimensions: the locus of causality , distinguishing internal from external causes; stability , describing whether a cause persists over time; and controllability , concerning whether the agent could have acted otherwise ( Weiner, 1985 ; Weiner, 1986 ) . In the responsibility model (Figure 7(a) ), perceivers first assess whether an outcome reflects personal or situational causality. When personal causality is implicated, they evaluate controllability and consider mitigating circumstances before assigning responsibility ( Weiner, 1995 ) . The model therefore distinguishes an agent’s causal contribution from the extent to which the agent can reasonably be held responsible for it.
blocks.zh: Weiner通过可分离的维度来描述因果关系的解释:因果关系的发生地,区分内部原因和外部原因;稳定性,描述一个原因是否长期存在;以及可控制性,关于代理人是否可采取其他行动(Weiner,1985;Weiner,1986)。 在责任模式(图7(a))中,感知者首先评估某一结果是否反映个人或情况因果关系。 在涉及个人因果关系时,他们评价可控制性,并在指定责任之前考虑减轻情节(Weiner,1995年)。 因此,该模式将代理人的因果关系与代理人可以合理承担责任的程度区分开来。

blocks.en: Shaver describes blame for a negative consequence as a structured assessment of responsibility-relevant variables ( Shaver, 1985 ; Shaver and Drown, 1986 ) . As illustrated in Figure 7(b) , the assessment begins by distinguishing human agency from impersonal causes. When human agency is involved, subsequent assessments concern whether the agent foresaw the outcome, intended it, and acted voluntarily rather than under coercion. Justifications and excuses can further mitigate blame. These distinctions explain why similar outcomes can support different judgments depending on the agent’s knowledge, intentions, and freedom of action. They also motivate treating responsibility and blame as separate targets: mitigating information can reduce blame even when responsibility remains.
blocks.zh: Shaver将负后果的责任描述为对责任相关变量的有条理的评估(Shaver, 1985;Shaver和Droown, 1986)。 如图7(b)所示,评估首先要区分人的身体与非个人原因。 在涉及人类机构时,随后的评估涉及代理人是否预见结果、意图结果以及是否自愿而不是在胁迫下采取行动。 理由和借口可以进一步减轻责任。 这些区别解释了为什么类似的结果可以支持不同的判断,取决于代理人的知识、意图和行动自由。 它们也促使将责任和指责作为单独的目标:即使责任依然存在,减轻信息也可以减少指责。

blocks.en: The Path Model of Blame (PMoB) specifies when different information becomes relevant to blame judgments ( Malle et al., 2014 ) . After assessing causality, perceivers evaluate intentionality, which separates two subsequent paths (Figure 7(c) ). For intentional conduct, reasons and their justificatory force are central. For unintentional conduct, preventability becomes central, including whether the agent had an obligation and the capacity to prevent the outcome. New information can revise an earlier assessment and redirect the judgment along the other path. This conditional structure is particularly relevant to our inclusion of supervisory obligations and command–obedience relations: a social role can affect responsibility and blame even when the agent did not directly intend the negative outcome.
blocks.zh: " 责任之路模型 " (PMoB)规定,当不同的信息与指责判决相关时(Malle等人,2014年)。 在评估了因果关系后,感知者评价了故意性,这分离了后两条路径(图7(c). 就故意行为而言,理由及其正当性是核心。 对于非故意行为,可预防性成为中心,包括代理人是否有义务和有能力防止结果。 新的信息可以修改早先的评估,并将判断方向转向另一条道路。 这种有条件的结构与我们纳入监督义务和指挥-服从关系特别相关:即使代理人没有直接意图造成负面结果,社会作用也会影响责任和责备。

blocks.en: A.2 Operational Definitions of Attribution Dimensions
blocks.zh: A.2 分配方面的业务定义

blocks.en: We select five dimensions that are recurrent in attribution accounts and can be represented explicitly in controlled scenarios or annotated in reconstructed narratives. The operationalizations support comparisons across scenarios while preserving distinctions that would be obscured by a single overall judgment. They do not reproduce every construct or dependency in any one theory. In particular, causality provides part of the scenario context, whereas the five annotated dimensions describe mental states, constraints, capacities, and obligations associated with a target agent.
blocks.zh: 我们选择五个层面,这些层面在归属账户中反复出现,并且可以明确体现在可控情景中,或者在重建的叙述中附加说明。 实际操作有助于对各种设想进行比较,同时保留被单一的总体判断所掩盖的区别。 它们并不重复任何一种理论中的每一个构象或依赖。 特别是,因果关系提供了情景背景的一部分,而五个附加说明的维度则描述了与目标物剂有关的精神状态、制约因素、能力和义务。

blocks.en: We operationalize intention at the level of the focal action: whether the agent deliberately performed it according to a goal or plan. This is action-intention , which need not imply a purpose to bring about the eventual negative outcome. Some attribution accounts use intention in the latter, outcome-directed sense ( Shaver, 1985 ; Shaver and Drown, 1986 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) . Maintaining the distinction allows the benchmark to vary deliberate action and foreknowledge separately. Their conjunction represents acting while foreseeing a consequence, without equating foresight with a desire to produce that consequence ( Mao et al., 2011 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们在协调行动一级将意图付诸实施:无论代理人是否根据目标或计划有意执行。 这是行动意图,它不一定意味着实现最终消极结果的目的。 一些归属账户使用后者的意向,结果导向意义(Shaver,1985;Shaver和Droown,1986;Malle等,2014.). 保持这种区分,使基准能够分别改变有意行动和预知。 他们的结合是行动,同时预想着一种后果,而不把远见等同于产生这种后果的愿望(毛泽东等,2011年)。

blocks.en: Voluntariness concerns whether the agent’s choice was substantially constrained by coercion, authority, or situational pressure. An explicit threat is not required: compliance with an authority can also constrain the choice. This dimension therefore separates freely chosen actions from actions performed under orders or pressure ( Shaver, 1985 ; Mao et al., 2011 ) . It is distinct from practical controllability. Following the distinction used in Mao et al. (2011) , information about control remains relevant when voluntariness is absent, because constrained choice alone does not specify which alternatives were practically available to the agent.
blocks.zh: 自愿性涉及代理人的选择是否受到胁迫、权威或情势压力的严重限制。 不需要有明确的威胁:遵守当局的规定也可能限制选择。 因此,这一层面将自由选择的行动与在命令或压力下采取的行动区分开来(Shaver,1985年;Mao等人,2011年)。 它不同于实际的可控制性。 在Mao等人(2011年)中使用的区别之后,当缺乏自愿性时,关于控制的信息仍然具有相关性,因为仅受限制的选择并不能说明该剂实际上有哪些替代品。

blocks.en: Foreknowledge concerns whether the agent knew that the action could lead to the eventual outcome or, given the agent’s epistemic and cognitive conditions, should have been able to foresee it. The assessment thus depends on information available at the time of acting, rather than knowledge acquired after the event. Foreknowledge can increase attributed responsibility and blame even when the negative outcome was not the agent’s goal ( Shaver, 1985 ) .
blocks.zh: 事先知道的问题是,代理人是否知道这一行动可能导致最终结果,或者,鉴于代理人的认知和认知条件,应该能够预见到这一点。 因此,评估取决于行动时可获得的信息,而不是事件后获得的知识。 即使负面结果不是代理人的目标(Shaver, 1985年),

blocks.en: We restrict controllability to the agent’s physical or practical ability to prevent the outcome, including relevant means, skills, and opportunities. In PMoB, preventability can also involve the capacity to foresee the outcome ( Malle et al., 2014 ) . We represent that epistemic component through foreknowledge, following the analytical separation of knowledge and control in our benchmark. This choice allows probing to distinguish knowing about a risk from having the practical capacity to avert it.
blocks.zh: 我们把可控性限于代理人防止结果的物理或实际能力,包括相关手段、技能和机会。 在PMoB中,可预防性也可能涉及预测结果的能力(Malle等人,2014年)。 在我们的基准中对知识和控制进行分析区分之后,我们通过前知识来代表这一认识部分。 这种选择使得人们能够将了解风险与实际有能力避免风险加以区分。

blocks.en: Obligation concerns a duty of care, supervision, or prevention arising from the social situation and the agent’s role or relationship. It is particularly relevant to unintentional outcomes and omissions, where an agent may bear responsibility or blame despite not performing the action that directly produced the harm ( Malle et al., 2014 ) . Unlike broader uses of obligation that also include a subordinate’s duty to obey a superior ( Mao et al., 2011 ) , our operationalization concerns the duty to prevent the negative outcome. This boundary keeps supervisory responsibility distinct from obedience within a command relationship.
blocks.zh: 义务涉及因社会状况和代理人的作用或关系而产生的照料、监督或预防义务。 它与无意结果和遗漏特别相关,因为代理人可能要承担责任或责备,尽管没有采取直接造成损害的行动(Malle等人,2014年)。 与更广泛的义务(包括下级服从上级的责任)不同(毛泽东等,2011年),我们的运作涉及防止负面结果的责任。 这一边界使监督责任有别于指挥关系中的服从。

blocks.en: The binary values indicate the presence or absence of each operationalized factor; ∅ \varnothing denotes an unspecified or inapplicable value, as defined in the main text. The definitions guide the construction of Vignette scenarios and the annotation of Reality narratives. The annotation materials and instructions are provided in Appendix B.4 .

blocks.en: A.3 Theoretical Positioning and Directional Expectations
blocks.zh: A.3. 理论定位和方向预期

blocks.en: Human attribution theory supplies a principled reference for selecting variables, constructing data, and specifying hypotheses about LLM judgments. It does not require assuming that LLMs instantiate human cognitive processes. This distinction is central to the study design: the benchmark measures agreement with human judgments, the probes measure whether theory-derived dimensions can be recovered from hidden states, and the interventions examine whether directions associated with those dimensions affect outputs in the expected way. Together, these analyses connect behavioral agreement to internal representations while allowing the model’s patterns to differ from the theoretical reference.
blocks.zh: 人类归属论为选择变量,构建数据,并具体说明关于LLM判断的假设提供了原则参考. 它并不要求假设LLMS会即时化人类认知过程. 这种区分对研究设计至关重要:基准计量与人类判断一致,探测器衡量理论衍生的维度能否从隐藏状态中恢复,干预则审查与这些维度相关的方向是否以预期方式影响产出. 这些分析将行为一致与内部表述联系起来,同时允许模型的模式与理论参考不同.

blocks.en: In the negative-outcome scenarios considered here, intention, voluntariness, foreknowledge, practical control, and obligation provide reasons for assigning greater responsibility or blame when other relevant circumstances are comparable ( Shaver, 1985 ; Weiner, 1995 ; Mao and Gratch, 2012 ; Malle et al., 2014 ) . We use this shared directional pattern to formulate an empirical expectation: strengthening the representation associated with a factor tends to increase the judgment, whereas weakening it tends to decrease the judgment. The positive probe direction corresponds to greater evidence for the factor’s presence under our operationalization.
blocks.zh: 在本文所考虑的负面结果假设中,意图、自愿、先入为主、实际控制和义务提供了在其他相关情况可比较时赋予更大责任或责备的理由(Shaver,1985年;Weiner,1995年;Mao and Gratch,2012年;Malle等人,2014年)。 我们利用这种共同的方向模式来形成实证预期:加强与某一因素相关的代表性往往会增加判断力,而削弱判断力则会减少判断力。 积极的探测方向与我们操作时该因素存在的更多证据相对应。

blocks.en: These expectations are conditional tendencies, not universal additive rules. The classic models distinguish intentional and unintentional conduct and allow justifications, excuses, and social relationships to change the relevance of a factor. Deliberately performing an action, for example, does not by itself establish an intention to cause harm or settle blameworthiness. Our directional tests therefore assess aggregate consistency with the stated hypothesis within the benchmark and intervention setting; they do not require every individual scenario to follow the same monotonic relation. The inferential limits of this evidence are discussed in Appendix H.2 .
blocks.zh: 这些期望是有条件的倾向,而不是通用的添加剂规则. 经典模式区分了故意和无意行为,允许理由、借口和社会关系改变一个因素的相关性。 例如,故意采取某项行动本身并不能确定造成伤害或解决责任问题的意图。 因此,我们的方向测试在基准和干预设定中评估与所述假设的总体一致性;这些测试并不要求每个个别情景遵循相同的单一关系。 附录H.2讨论了这种证据的推断限度。

blocks.zh: B.3 LLM-辅助数据建设的提示

blocks.en:
LLMs assist with reconstruction, cleaning, and quality inspection;
they do not supply the final responsibility or blame labels.
Those judgments are assigned by human experts.
The reconstruction prompt takes an AITA post as input and returns
the scenario background and agent descriptions.
The inspection prompt specifies retention criteria and returns a
decision with its reason.
Both steps require valid JSON without additional prose.

blocks.en: We used the following prompt to transform raw Reddit posts into concise benchmark-style social scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们用以下的提示将原始的Reddit帖子转变为简明的基准式社会情景.

blocks.en:
You are helping construct a dataset for social attribution research. Given a Reddit AITA post, rewrite it as a concise third-person story. Requirements:
(1) Keep only the core plot related to the interpersonal conflict and the negative outcome.
(2) Preserve the main agents, their actions, relevant knowledge, constraints, and consequences.
(3) Remove irrelevant metadata, voting information, comments, edits, usernames, hyperlinks, and platform-specific expressions.
(4) Remove slang, offensive wording, harmful or biased expressions, and private personal information.
(5) Replace real or specific personal names with fictional names.
(6) Do not add new facts, motives, or outcomes that are not supported by the original post.
(7) Write the output in a neutral and clear style. Return only a valid JSON object. Do not include markdown, comments, explanations, or any text outside the JSON object. The JSON object must contain the following fields: • story_background : a concise third-person description of the core event and the negative outcome. • character_details : a list of short descriptions of the main agents. Each item should describe one agent’s relevant actions, knowledge, constraints, or role.

(7)以中性而清晰的风格来写出输出. 只返回一个有效的 JSON 对象 。 不包括下标,注释,解释,或JSON对象外的任何文本. JSON 对象必须包含以下字段: • 故事_背景 : 简洁的第三人称描述核心事件和负面结果。 • 性格_细节:主要代理人简介列表. 每个项目应说明一个代理人的有关行动、知识、限制或作用。

blocks.zh: B.4 人类注释议定书和准则

blocks.en:
The annotation procedure has two stages.
For Reality , human annotators assign values to the five
attribution dimensions for the target agent in each reconstructed
story: intention, voluntariness, foreknowledge, controllability,
and obligation.
Unlike Vignette , these narratives have no pre-designed
dimension settings.
For both subsets, annotators then assign the final responsibility
and blame judgments.
Thus, Vignette dimension values come from construction,
whereas its judgments are human-annotated; Reality has human annotations for both.

blocks.en: You will read a reconstructed real-world social scenario. For each target agent, please annotate the following five attribution dimensions: intention , voluntariness , foreknowledge , controllability , and obligation . For each dimension, please choose one value from { 1 , 0 , ∅ } \{1,0,\varnothing\} : • Use 1 if the dimension is present for the target agent. • Use 0 if the dimension is clearly absent for the target agent. • Use ∅ \varnothing if the story does not provide enough information to determine the value. Please judge each dimension only based on the information explicitly stated or reasonably implied in the story. Do not infer hidden facts, motives, or background information that are not supported by the text. The five dimensions are defined as follows: • Intention : Judge whether the target agent deliberately performed the focal action. This refers to the intention behind the action itself, not necessarily the intention to cause the final negative outcome. • Voluntariness : Judge whether the target agent acted voluntarily, rather than under coercion, strong pressure, or direct command. • Foreknowledge : Judge whether the target agent knew, or should reasonably have been able to foresee, that the action could lead to the negative outcome. • Controllability : Judge whether the target agent had the practical ability, opportunity, or means to prevent or avoid the negative outcome. • Obligation : Judge whether the target agent had a role-based, relational, or situational duty to prevent the negative outcome.

blocks.en: You will read a social scenario, the description of a target agent, and a question asking how much responsibility the target agent should bear for the negative outcome. Please choose one label from { no , low , medium , high }. When making the judgment, please consider whether the target agent contributed to the negative outcome, whether the agent could have acted otherwise, whether the agent had relevant knowledge or control, and whether the agent had a relevant role or duty in the event. The four labels are defined as follows: • high : Choose this label if the target agent is a central source of the negative outcome and should clearly bear strong responsibility. • medium : Choose this label if the target agent makes a substantial contribution to the negative outcome, but the degree of responsibility is limited by mitigating factors such as limited knowledge, limited control, or role constraints. • low : Choose this label if the target agent is only weakly or indirectly connected to the negative outcome, or if there are strong mitigating factors. • no : Choose this label if the target agent should not be held responsible based on the given scenario.

blocks.en: You will read a social scenario, the description of a target agent, and a question asking how much the target agent should be blamed for the negative outcome. Please choose one label from { no , low , medium , high }. When making the judgment, please consider not only whether the target agent contributed to the outcome, but also whether the agent acted intentionally, knowingly, voluntarily, or in violation of a reasonable expectation or obligation. Please also consider whether there are excuses or mitigating circumstances. The four labels are defined as follows: • high : Choose this label if the target agent clearly deserves strong blame for the negative outcome. • medium : Choose this label if the target agent deserves a moderate degree of blame, but the blame is reduced by mitigating factors. • low : Choose this label if the target agent deserves only slight blame because the action, knowledge, control, or obligation is limited. • no : Choose this label if the target agent should not be blamed based on the given scenario. A person may be responsible for an outcome but receive lower blame if they lacked intention, foreknowledge, voluntariness, or sufficient control. Please make the responsibility and blame judgments separately according to the specific question.

blocks.en: B.5 Inter-Annotator Agreement
blocks.zh: B.5 通知员 协议

blocks.en:
We measure agreement on responsibility and blame judgments before
agreement-based filtering.
Exact agreement across all 8,800 questions is 86.8%.
We also report Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) ,
linearly weighted κ lin \kappa_{\mathrm{lin}} ( Cohen, 1968 ) , and quadratically weighted κ quad \kappa_{\mathrm{quad}} ( Fleiss and Cohen, 1973 ) .
Unweighted κ \kappa adjusts exact agreement for agreement expected
from the annotators’ marginal label distributions.
The weighted measures additionally account for the ordered labels,
with quadratic weighting penalizing larger disagreements more heavily.
Reporting all three distinguishes disagreement about an exact level
from disagreement across more distant judgment levels.

The behavioral evaluation measures agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments at two complementary levels: the label assigned to an individual agent and the relative ordering of agents within a scenario.

blocks.en:

The ‘‘closed-source’’ grouping used in the results follows the access mode in these experiments: Kimi, MiMo, and Step are included in this group because we used their official APIs, although their weights have also been publicly released.
The open-source group consists of instruction-tuned or chat models.
For the behavioral benchmark, these models are deployed through Ollama 4 4 4 https://ollama.com/ , with temperature set to 0 and random seed set to 0.
The hidden-state experiments use the separate backbone configuration described in Appendix D .

blocks.en:
The five non-LLM baselines provide complementary reference points: label-frequency information, surface textual cues, an explicit attribution-theory rule, and supervised text classification.
Each predicts one of no , low , medium , or high for responsibility and blame and is evaluated with the metrics in Appendix C.4 .
Their information sources differ: in particular, the Attribution-Theory Rule receives annotated attribution dimensions, whereas the text-based methods must work from the narrative.
The results should be interpreted with this distinction in mind.
blocks.zh:
五个非LLM基线提供了互补的参考点:标签频率信息,表面文字提示,明确的归属理论规则,以及受监督的文字分类.
每个指标都预测没有、低、中或高度的责任和指责,并用附录C.4中的衡量尺度加以评价。
它们的信息来源不同:特别是, " 归属-理论规则 " 得到附加说明的归属层面,而以文字为基础的方法必须从叙述中发挥作用。
对结果的解释应铭记这种区别。

blocks.en:
For each task–subset combination, mBERT uses five random splits with 90% of the data for training and 10% for testing.
For a fair comparison among the non-LLM baselines, the other four methods use the same test sets, and accuracy is computed from the pooled test predictions across the five runs.
blocks.zh:
对于每个任务-子集组合,mBERT使用5个随机分数,90%的数据用于培训,10%用于测试.
为了对非LLM基线进行公平比较,其他四种方法使用相同的成套测试,准确性根据五行的集合测试预测计算。

blocks.en:
This baseline samples a label at random according to the empirical label distribution of the corresponding task and dataset subset.
It does not use the scenario text, attribution dimensions, or any learned parameters.
It measures how much performance can be obtained from label balance alone.
blocks.zh:
此基线根据相应任务和数据集子集的经验性标签分布随机取出标签.
它不使用情景文本、归属维度或任何学到的参数。
它衡量单靠标签平衡就可以获得多少性能.

blocks.en:
This baseline always predicts the most frequent label in the corresponding task and dataset subset.
Ties are broken by the fixed label order no , low , medium , high .
It provides a reference for the contribution of the dominant class to exact agreement.
blocks.zh:
这个基准总是预测相应任务和数据集子集中最频繁的标签.
铁丝网被固定的标签顺序打破 没有,低,中,高。
它为主导阶级对确切协议的贡献提供了参考。

blocks.en:
This baseline uses only surface cues from the scenario text and does not use the annotated attribution dimensions.
For each record, it first focuses on the sentence or paragraph mentioning the target agent when possible, and otherwise uses the full scenario.
It then matches English and Chinese keywords related to causal involvement, intention, foreknowledge, control, obligation, coercion, inability, accident, justification, and lack of knowledge.
Responsibility is scored mainly from causal involvement, control, obligation, foreknowledge, and intention, with penalties for coercion and mitigation.
Blame gives more weight to intention and foreknowledge, and applies stronger penalties for coercion, accident, justification, and lack of knowledge.
The final score is mapped to the four labels by fixed thresholds: scores at or below zero give no , one gives low , two or three give medium , and four or above gives high .
This baseline tests how much of the benchmark can be handled through explicit surface matching.
blocks.zh:
这一基准只使用情景文本中的表面提示,而不使用附加说明的归属维度.
对于每一项记录,它首先侧重于在可能时提及目标代理人的句子或段落,并用到全景.
然后与英文和中文关键词相匹配,这些关键词涉及因果关系、意图、前知、控制、义务、胁迫、无力、事故、正当理由和缺乏知识。
责任主要来自因果参与、控制、义务、事先知情和意图,对胁迫和减轻处罚。
指责更重视意向和先入为主,并对胁迫、事故、辩解和缺乏知识实施更严厉的惩罚。
最终得分通过固定阈值被映射到四个标签上:0分或以下的分数给予不,1分给予低.,2分或3分给予中.,4分或以上给予高.
这一基线测试了有多少基准可以通过明确的地表匹配处理。

blocks.en:
This baseline uses the annotated attribution dimensions rather than the raw scenario text.
It follows a Mao-and-Gratch-inspired rule over five binary dimensions ( Mao and Gratch, 2012 ) : intention, obligation, voluntariness, controllability, and foreknowledge.
Missing or not-applicable dimension values are treated as zero.
The responsibility rule uses controllability as a key prerequisite, reduces judgments for non-voluntary action, and assigns higher levels in conjunction with intention, foreknowledge, and obligation.
The blame rule uses the same dimensions but is more sensitive to lack of voluntariness and lack of foreknowledge, because these factors provide stronger mitigation for blame.
This comparison assesses the utility of explicitly supplied attribution factors, while also giving the rule a different input advantage from the LLMs and text classifiers.
blocks.zh:
这一基线使用附加说明的归属方面,而不是原始设想案文。
它遵循了毛泽东和格拉特克启发的关于五个二元维度的统治(毛泽东和格拉特克,2012年):意图,义务,自愿,可控性,以及先入为主.
缺少或不适用的维值作为零处理。
责任规则将可控性作为关键先决条件,减少对非自愿行动的判断,并结合意图、预知和义务指派更高的级别。
指责规则使用相同的维度,但对缺乏自愿性和缺乏前科更为敏感,因为这些因素为指责提供了更强有力的缓解.
这种比较评估了明确提供的归属因子的效用,同时也使规则具有与LLMs和文本分类器不同的输入优势.

blocks.en:
This baseline is a supervised, non-generative encoder model.
We fine-tune bert-base-multilingual-cased 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/google-bert/bert-base-multilingual-cased with a four-way classification head, using the scenario text as input and the gold attribution label as the target.
Responsibility and blame are trained as separate classification tasks.
Unlike the frequency and hand-written rule baselines, mBERT tests whether supervised learning from the available text–judgment pairs is sufficient to reproduce the annotated judgments.
blocks.zh:
这个基线是一个受监督的非再生编码器模型.
我们微调了bert-base-多语种案例 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/google-bert/bert-base-多语种案例,以四行分类为主,以情景文本为输入,以黄金归属标签为目标.
责任和指责作为单独的分类任务加以培训。
与频率和手写规则基线不同, mBERT测试在监督下学习现有文本-判断对是否足以复制附加说明的判断.

blocks.en: Complete baseline results and their comparison with the LLMs are given in Appendix E , Table 15 .
blocks.zh: 完整的基线结果及其与有限责任项目之间的比较见附录E表15。

blocks.zh: 附录D 探测和干预细节

blocks.en: The representation experiments test decodability and theory-aligned influence separately. The implementation below specifies the controls and token-position comparisons; Appendices F and G report their results.

blocks.en: D.1 Backbones and Hidden-State Extraction
blocks.zh: D.1 后骨和隐藏状态开采

We use five frozen backbones with CoT prompts: DeepSeek-R1-1.5B (28 Transformer layers), Llama-3.2-1B (16), Llama-3.1-8B (32), Qwen3-4B (36), and Qwen3-8B (36).
The main decodability analysis probes every Transformer layer.
For cross-model comparison, layer depth is normalized by each model’s total number of layers; 100% denotes the final layer.
The selected intervention layers are given in Table 11 .

主要可解析性分析探测出每个变相器层.

The last input token is a distinct, earlier position at the end of the prompt, before the generated CoT response.
Probing this position tests whether dimension information is already accessible before the final judgment stage.
Intervening there tests whether a local perturbation can propagate through subsequent autoregressive generation to affect the final answer.
These complementary comparisons are reported in Appendices F.2 and G.1 .

测试这一位置,测试在最后判决阶段之前是否已经可以获得维度信息。

blocks.en: D.2 Data Splits and Result Aggregation
blocks.zh: D.2 数据分割和结果汇总

blocks.en:
Probes are trained and evaluated separately for each language and each subset.
Keeping Chinese and English versions in separate runs prevents a translated version of a held-out scenario from appearing in that probe’s training data.
blocks.zh:
为每种语言和每一子集分别培训和评价了探测器。
中文版和英文版分开运行,无法在探测器的训练数据中出现被搁置情景的译出版本。

blocks.en:
The eight scenario types describe event settings, whereas the three inter-agent relation categories describe how agents are related (Appendix B.1 ).
We use eight-fold leave-one-scenario-type-out cross-validation: each fold holds out all samples of one scenario type for testing and uses the other seven types for training.
Occurrences of the same type across relation categories belong to the same fold, including all their agent questions and narrative variants.
For example, a Company test fold includes Company templates from General, Vicarious Blame, and Commanding Chain; a Laboratory test fold includes both of its relation-specific templates in Table 1 .
Each scenario type is held out once.
Withholding entire event settings limits the opportunity to memorize recurring scenario content or templates, reducing the risk of inflated decodability from such overlap.
The resulting evaluation tests whether attribution dimensions can be decoded in unseen scenario types, strengthening the evidence for generalization across event settings.
blocks.zh:
八种情景类型描述事件设置,而三种代理关系类别则描述代理关系如何关联(附录B.1.
我们使用八倍的假想型(leave-One-scenario-type-out)交叉验证:每个折叠将一个假想型的所有样本都保留出来进行测试,并利用其他七个型号进行培训.
各种关系类别的同类型事件属于同一种折叠,包括所有代理问题和叙事变体.
例如,公司测试折叠包括来自General、Vicarious Blame和Commanding Chain的公司模板;实验室测试折叠包括表1中与公司关系相关的两个模板。
每种情况都存在一次。
保留整个事件设置限制了记忆反复出现的情况情景内容或模板的机会,减少了这种重叠导致被夸大可解码性的风险.
由此而来的评价检验了归属维度能否被解码为隐形情景类型,加强了跨事件设置的通论证据.

blocks.en:
We use 10-fold random cross-validation, training on nine folds and testing on the remaining fold in each round.
The same subset-specific splits are used for the original probes and decodability controls at both the label-token prediction step and the last input token.
blocks.zh:
我们使用10倍的随机交叉验证,9个折叠的训练以及每轮剩余折叠的测试.
同样的子集特定分解在标签-token预测步骤和上一个输入符上都用于原始探测器和可解码控制.

blocks.en:
For dimension k k , training and evaluation require a non-missing label y i , k ∈ { 0 , 1 } y_{i,k}\in\{0,1\} and an available hidden state at the probed location.
Questions with unspecified or inapplicable values are excluded for that dimension; they need not be excluded from other dimensions for which labels are available.
Consequently, the eligible sample set can differ across dimensions.
All probe fitting and direction construction use training-fold data; interventions are evaluated on held-out prompts.
blocks.zh:
对于维度 k k, 训练和评价需要有一个不丢失的标签 y i, k {} { 0, 1} y_{i, k}\in\{0, 1\} 和被探测地点可用的隐藏状态 .
关于这一方面,没有具体或不适用价值的问题不在此列;它们不必被排除在有标签的其他方面之外。
因此,合格样本组合可因不同方面而异。
所有探测器的安装和方向建造都使用培训方面的数据;干预措施按停放的提示加以评价。

blocks.en:
For a fixed language–subset combination, model, task, dimension, and layer, we compute balanced accuracy on each held-out fold and take the unweighted mean over the eight Vignette folds or the ten Reality folds.
This is the summary for an individual language–subset run.
For the combined decodability plots, we instead collect the held-out predictions and labels from all folds of all four language–subset runs and recompute balanced accuracy on that pooled set.
Each eligible question contributes the prediction from its test fold.
Thus, the combined score is computed from pooled predictions, rather than by averaging the fold means or the four run-level scores; these aggregations can differ when fold sizes or class frequencies differ.
Probe training is repeated with seeds 0, 1, and 2, and the resulting scores are averaged across seeds.
Pooling predictions for reporting does not entail fitting a joint bilingual probe.
Balanced accuracy gives the two binary dimension values equal importance, which is necessary because their label frequencies differ.
It is distinct from benchmark accuracy, whose targets are the four human responsibility/blame labels.
blocks.zh:
对于固定语言-子集组合,模型,任务,维度和层等,我们计算出每个被扣起的折叠的平衡精度,并将未加权的正值取出八个Vignette折叠或十个Reality折叠.
这是单个语言- subset 运行的摘要 。
对于合并的可解码地块,我们收集所有四种语言-子集运行的所有折叠的被搁置的预测和标签,并重新计算该集合集的平衡准确性。
每个合格问题都有助于从测试折叠中作出预测。
因此,综合分数是从集合预测计算,而不是通过折叠手段或四个跑级分数的平均值来计算;当折叠大小或类频率不同时,这些汇总会有所不同.
探测训练以0,1和2等种子重复进行,所得分数由种子平均计算出.
汇集报告预测不需要安装联合双语探测器。
平衡的精度使两个二元值具有同等的重要性,这是必要的,因为它们的标签频率不同.
它不同于基准准确性,其目标为四项人的责任/指责标签。

High probe accuracy alone does not establish that the model represents the intended construct independently of superficial text patterns ( Hewitt and Liang, 2019 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) .
The vignette construction therefore varies narrative phrasing and character identities and avoids explicit dimension labels; leaving entire scenario types out of training further reduces shortcuts based on recurring event settings.
We complement these design choices with three controls, using the same splits, class-balanced logistic classifier, and balanced-accuracy metric.

高探测精度本身并不能证明该模型代表了独立于表面文字图案的预期构造(Hewitt和Liang,2019;Belinkov,2022.
因此,vignette构建方式不同了叙事措辞和字符身份,并避免了明显的维度标签;将整个情景类型排除在培训之外会进一步减少基于经常性事件设置的快捷键.
我们用三种控制来补充这些设计选择,使用相同的分法、分类平衡的后勤分类和平衡精确度的度量衡。

blocks.en:
For each dimension and training fold, we randomly permute the training labels while leaving hidden states and test labels unchanged.
This preserves the training-label counts but removes their original correspondence with the representations.
It tests whether held-out performance depends on that correspondence rather than on label balance or the probe-fitting procedure alone.
blocks.zh:
对于每一个维度和训练折叠,我们随机地将训练标签固定,同时保留隐藏状态和测试标签不变.
这保留了培训标签的计数,但删除了他们与陈述的原始通信。
它检验被搁置的性能是否取决于这种对应关系,而不是仅仅取决于标签平衡或探测器适应程序。

blocks.en:
We replace hidden states with character 3–5-gram TF-IDF features extracted from the scenario text alone.
This control measures predictive information available from surface text without using the LLM’s hidden representations or generated reasoning.
The original-probe and control curves in Appendix F.1 therefore provide complementary evidence: shuffled labels check the label–representation association, while random projection and lexical features compare the full representation with restricted alternatives.
blocks.zh:
我们用仅从情景文本中提取的字符 3–5克 TF-IDF 特性来取代隐藏状态。
这种控制措施在不使用LLM隐藏的表示或产生推理的情况下,从表面文本中获取预测性信息。
因此,附录F.1中的原始测试和控制曲线提供了补充证据:被洗牌的标签检查标签-代表关系,而随机投影和词汇特征则将完全代表与受限制的替代品进行比较.

blocks.en: D.4 Intervention Implementation and Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: D.4 干预执行和超参数

blocks.en:
At each selected layer and training fold, we derive a direction from the target dimension’s probe weight.
Equation 2 removes components explained by the other available dimension-probe weights using regularized residualization, then normalizes the residual to unit length.
This reduces shared linear components among correlated dimensions; it does not establish complete independence among the underlying attribution factors.
Degenerate residuals are skipped.
The positive direction is oriented to increase probe evidence for y i , k = 1 y_{i,k}=1 .
The directional expectations apply to the negative-outcome scenarios considered here, as discussed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
在每一层和训练层中,我们从目标维度的探测器重量中得出一个方向。
方程式2去除由其他可得到的维度-探测分量所解释的组件,使用正态化的残基,再将残基恢复正常为单位长度.
这减少了相关维度之间共有的线性组成部分;它并没有在基本归属因素之间建立完全的独立性。
脱源残留被跳出.
正面方向旨在为y i, k = 1 y _{i, k}= 1 增加探测证据.

blocks.en: Appendix F Additional Decodability Analyses

blocks.en: The main decodability analysis asks whether theory-derived dimensions can be recovered from hidden states. Above-chance accuracy alone does not establish what information a probe uses or whether that information is specific to the final judgment stage. We therefore examine controls for alternative predictive signals and compare two token positions.
blocks.zh: 主要可解析性分析询问理论衍生的维度是否能够从隐藏状态中恢复. 仅凭超能力准确性并不能确定探测器使用何种信息,或该信息是否是最后判断阶段所特有的。 因此,我们审查对替代预测信号的控制,并比较两个象征性位置。

blocks.en: F.1 Decodability Sanity Checks
blocks.zh: F.1 可解密性检查

blocks.en: The controls target three distinct concerns about the probing measurement. Shuffling training labels tests dependence on the original dimension–representation association; random projection tests how much decodability is retained after compressing the representation to 64 features; and scenario-text TF-IDF measures the information available from lexical surface cues. All use the same data splits, classifier family, and balanced-accuracy metric as the main probes (Appendix D.3 ): eight folds holding out one scenario type at a time for Vignette , and ten random folds for Reality . Together with diversified vignette wording, holding out entire scenario types reduces opportunities to exploit familiar event settings; the controls further assess dependence on the tested representation and surface features.

blocks.en: F.2 Decodability at the Last Input Token
blocks.zh: F.2 最后输入键的可解码性

blocks.en: The main probes read the hidden state used to predict the final judgment label, where information from the prompt and preceding generated reasoning is available. A possible concern is that decodability at this position reflects only the immediate answer-selection stage. To examine whether attribution information is accessible earlier, we instead extract the hidden state at the last token of the input prompt, before the model generates its response, and train the same type of probes. Figure 15 compares this last-input-token position with the label-token prediction step.
blocks.zh: 主要探测器读取了用于预测最终判断标签的隐藏状态,其中提供了来自即时和之前生成的推理的信息. 一个可能的关切是,这一立场的可解码性仅仅反映了即时的答案选择阶段。 为了检查归属信息是否可以更早地获取,我们转而从输入快取出隐藏状态的最后一个符号,在模型产生反应之前,并训练出同一种探测器. 图15 将这个最后输入键位置与标签键预测步骤进行比较。

blocks.en: Attribution dimensions are already strongly decodable at the earlier position. Averaged over the displayed models, dimensions, and layers, balanced accuracy is 73.8% at the last input token and 71.1% at the label-token prediction step. Four of the five models have higher average decodability at the input position, with the largest difference in DeepSeek-R1-1.5B. Qwen3-8B is the main exception: its later position improves decoding of voluntariness, foreknowledge, and controllability. Llama-3.2-1B also improves on voluntariness at the later position.
blocks.zh: 在较早的位置,分配维度已经很可解码。 平均在显示的模型、尺寸和地层上,平衡准确度在最后输入符上为73.8%,在标注的预测步骤上为71.1%。 5个型号中,有4个型号在输入位置有较高的平均可解码性,在DeepSeek-R1-1.5B中差异最大. Qune3-8B是主要的例外:它的后期位置改善了自愿,前知,可控性的解码. Llama-3.2-1B在后期位置也改善了自愿性.

blocks.en: At both positions, decodability generally rises from early layers and peaks in the middle or later layers. Intention and obligation remain among the most decodable dimensions, and the layerwise curves often have similar shapes. This comparison shows that the measured attribution information is not confined to the final label-prediction step. It does not imply that generating reasoning uniformly increases decodability, or that the two positions implement the same computation. Whether an earlier representation can also influence the final judgment is examined separately in Appendix G.1 .
blocks.zh: 在这两个位置上,可解码性一般由早期地层起起,中间或后期地层有峰. 意向和义务仍然是最可解码的维度之一,分层曲线往往有相近的形状. 这种比较表明,所测量的归属信息并不局限于最终的标签-预测步骤. 这并不意味着生成推理会统一地增加可解码性,也不意味着这两个位置执行相同的计算. 附录G.1单独审查了较早的代表是否也可影响最后判决。

blocks.en: Decodability establishes that a dimension is accessible to a linear readout, but does not by itself show that changing the corresponding representation affects the model’s judgment. The intervention analyses address this distinction. Complementing the main directional-test heatmap in Figure 6 , we test an earlier intervention position and examine how directional changes vary with perturbation strength.
blocks.zh: 可解码性确定一个维度可以被线性读出,但本身并不表明改变相应的表示会影响模型的判断. 干预分析涉及这一区别。 作为图6中主要方向测试热图的补充,我们测试了较早的干预位置,并研究方向变化如何随扰动强度而变化.

blocks.en: G.1 Intervention at the Last Input Token
blocks.zh: G.1 最后输入键的干预

blocks.en: The main intervention edits a hidden state at the label-token prediction step. This position directly tests whether the learned attribution directions can influence the final judgment, but its proximity to the output leaves open whether the effect is restricted to local answer selection. The earlier-token comparison addresses this concern by moving both probe training and intervention to the last token of the input prompt.
blocks.zh: 主干预编辑了标签-token预测步骤上隐藏的状态. 这一立场直接检验所学的归属方向能否影响最终判断,但其与输出的相近性使得效果是否局限于本地的答案选择仍然没有定论. 较早的比较通过将探测培训和干预移到输入提示的最后一点来解决了这一关切。

blocks.en: For each prompt, we extract the last-input-token hidden state and train attribution-dimension probes at that position. We then perturb that state along the corresponding probe-derived direction and allow autoregressive generation to continue until the model produces its final attribution label. The selected layers, strengths, directional hypotheses, random-direction controls, and shuffled-label probe-direction controls follow the main intervention setup. Each comparison uses the same feasible signs ℰ i \mathcal{E}_{i} determined by the unedited output: a question succeeds only if every tested sign strictly aligns, as in Equation 5 ; ties count as failures and all questions remain in N N . We use the same one-sided exact binomial test with threshold 1 / 2 1/2 , requiring p c < 0.01 p_{c}<0.01 for all three comparisons (Appendix D.5 ). Unlike the main one-step label prediction, the earlier edit must propagate through subsequent generation before the final judgment is observed.

blocks.en: Figure 16 reports the earlier-position results at α = 8 \alpha=8 , using the same visual encoding as Figure 6 . Theory-aligned effects occur in several models and intermediate layers, particularly in the Llama family, but are unevenly distributed across models, dimensions, and layers. Together with Appendix F.2 , this separates two questions: attribution information can already be read out before response generation, whereas the directional tests assess whether an edit at that position affects the eventual judgment.

blocks.en: The surviving effects show that influence along these probe-derived directions is not confined to an edit immediately before the answer label. However, the model- and layer-dependent pattern limits claims about a broadly stable mechanism throughout generation. An earlier local perturbation may be attenuated or transformed during subsequent computation; the present comparison measures its eventual effect rather than identifying the specific process responsible for that attenuation.
blocks.zh: 幸存的效应表明,沿着这些探针衍生出的方向所施加的影响并不局限于在答案标签之前的编辑. 然而,模型和分层依赖的模式限制了整个一代人对一种大体稳定的机制的主张。 先前的局部扰动可能在随后的计算中被减弱或转变;本比较衡量其最终效果,而不是确定造成这种减弱的具体过程。
